description: Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs - Appoind Technical Consultative Committee for the Sri Lanka Cricket
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a regulation made under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973, specifically appointing a Technical Consultative Committee for Sri Lanka Cricket. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters - it cites specific sections of existing legislation (Section 41 and Section 39(3) of the Sports Law) and creates a regulatory framework through ministerial authority. While it does name individuals being appointed to the committee, this is done within the context of establishing a regulatory body under existing sports legislation, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel announcement.
